verdict.rationale: Fine-tuning is a fair question for a model API vendor, so the axis applies. The pack documents no hosted fine-tuning API and no tunable open weights. The only weights-related evidence describes Anthropic protecting its model weights, and Skills and prompt caching are adjacent customization features, not training on customer data.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune the vendor's models on my own data through a documented self-serve path — hosted fine-tuning API or tunable open weights
